title: Winter Awakens
description: A cruel winter experience in Minecraft with a ton of new mechanics & magic.
body:
The cruelest and most realistic Winter only modpack out there.

### Features
- Cruel Temperatures
- Hydration system
- Trees may fall on you
- 2048 world height
- New ores
- Magic features
- Wearable items & artifacts
- New Structures
- Reworked ender dragon & the end
- 2 new dimensions
- Many new boss fights
- A ton more stuff, play and find out

### Gameplay help
Check the saved recipes if you need help figuring out how to progress.
To fight the cold, go underground, even if you make a house on surface it won't be enough, stay away from mountains when choosing a home location.
Use the explorer's compass & nature's compass to find structures faster.

### CURRENT KNOWN MAJOR BUGS
- The nether portal will spawn above bedrock in nether if your y level is higher or lower than vanilla's world height level. Make a portal between Y -60 and 100
- Copper cauldron may crash your game when you right click on it. Use iron cauldron instead.
- The world may stop loading if the world size becomes too big. Just increase your ram to 64gb or something idk.
- The stronghold spawns on surface and may make a mess of its surrounding terrain.

## Note
- For extra immersion get the mod [physics-mod-pro-v172j-fabric-1.21.1.jar](https://www.patreon.com/posts/physics-mod-pro-143998999)

### Hardware requirements
- RAM: 32gb minimum, 40GB recommended (seriously. sorry. i tried my best to optimize it)
- Storage: 20gb (the world size IS HUGE)
- CPU: A fairly good one, nothing crazy
- GPU: Equivelant to RTX 2070 or RX 5700

this might be the most demanding modpack yet
